Author: Aparesh Kumar Singh
Bench: Deepak Roshan, Aparesh Kumar Singh
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 W.P (Pil) No. 171 of 2012
 Court on its own motion
 Versus
 State of Jharkhand and others
 ---
Coram: Hon'ble The Acting Chief Justice Hon'ble Mr. Justice Deepak Roshan
---

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For the Respondents: Mr. Manish Kumar, Sr. S.C-II Mr. Amit Mishra, A.C to Sr. S.C-II ---
39 / 06.01.2023 Matter was taken up after a long time on 23.12.2022 and was adjourned on the request of learned counsel for the State.

Learned counsel Mr. Manish Kumar, Senior Standing Counsel No. II submits that some more time may be granted to have latest up-date in the matter and also in regard to the query posed by this Court in the order dated 25.10.2019.

Reference may be made to the previous orders passed by this Court in the present PIL which would show that direction have been passed on a number of occasion for creation of certain posts under the Jharkhand State Food Safety Service (Recruitment, Promotion and Other Conditions) Rules,
2015 and their filling up.

entities.text:
Jharkhand State Food Safety Service (Recruitment, Promotion and Other Conditions) Rules,
2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the State would seek instruction on these aspects and give the up-date on the present status of related matters concerning observance and regulation of food safety standards in the State.
Matter be listed after four weeks on 10.02.2023.
Let the name of Mr. Manish Kumar, Sr. S.C-II appear in the cause list henceforth for the Respondent State.

(Aparesh Kumar Singh, A.C.J) (Deepak Roshan, J) Ranjeet/
